Ellen (product): Rolling out v3.8.0 today: Delegated Access Playbook for Private/VPC customers. It bundles an admin playbook, emergency-access guardrails, and on-demand signed audit artifacts. Opt-in only.

DeployBot: Rollout started: v3.8.0-delegated-playbook -> canary us-west-2 at 3779999965

Ellen (product): Why: customers asked for a single, prescriptive runbook + tooling for operator delegation that auditors can verify offline. This package includes a migration dry-run, recommended emergency windows, and a sample incident response sequence.

Diego (eng): Tech note: delegated identities use short-lived certs; we emit metrics for auth.failures and fallback.count. Bundles are signed locally and can be exported via `redwoodctl evidence export`.

Ruth (security): Compliance note: recommend enabling attestations and KMS-backed signing keys for auditors. Playbook includes an evidence checklist for SOC2/ISO requests and a verifier script.

Kai (docs): I'll publish the playbook KB and a shortened customer one-pager. Any preferred CLI snippets?

Ellen (product): Include these two minimal examples:
```
# run migration in dry-run
redwoodctl access migrate --to delegated --dry-run

# export signed audit artifact
redwoodctl evidence export --scope operators --out evidence-2026-04-05.tar.gz
```

Zoe (sales): Sales ask: short 1-line customer blurb?

Ellen (product): "Delegated Access Playbook gives you a prescriptive migration path, verifiable audit artifacts, and emergency fallbacks so you can delegate operator roles safely."

Diego (eng): Fallback detail: if delegated auth fails, system switches to host emergency operator for the configured window, logs the event in the bundle, and triggers a Console alert. Configurable cooldown prevents repeated fallbacks.

DeployBot: Canary completed at 3779999990, monitoring window 90m.

Kai (docs): Draft PR up in /kb/delegated-playbook, will ping for reviews.

Ruth (security): Adding HSM guidance and sample auditor questions to the KB.

Ellen (product): Action items: Ellen publish announcement + blurb; Diego validate staging migration; Kai publish KB; Ruth add HSM/audit notes; Zoe start pilot outreach. Please react with :thumbsup: when tasks done.
